CORE OBJECTIVES

Give yacht owners a clean dashboard to track the vessel’s status, location, maintenance schedule, upcoming charters, expenses, and service history.

Give managers the ability to input, update, approve, and oversee all operational data.

Give crew the ability to submit tasks, upload photos/videos, log issues, request supplies, and complete checklists.

User Roles & Permissions

Owner: View-only access to all operational data, maintenance logs, tracking, expenses, and uploaded media. Approve budgets or work orders.

Manager: Full creation/edit access. Can add crew, assign tasks, schedule maintenance, upload documents, and manage notifications.

Crew: Limited access to daily tasks, checklists, issue reporting, supply requests, safety forms, and photo/video uploads.

Dashboards

Owner Dashboard: Vessel status, live map tracking (integrate GPS/ AIS later), maintenance timeline, upcoming service due dates, charter calendar, expense summary, and unread updates.

Manager Dashboard: Global view of all vessels, pending approvals, overdue maintenance, open crew requests, and uploaded logs.

Okay, I understand. You want to enhance the existing React Native app with robust authentication features using Supabase. Here's a plan to implement the requested functionalities:

2.  **Secure Password Hashing:** Supabase Auth handles password hashing automatically using bcrypt or similar algorithms. You don't need to implement this manually.

3.  **Token Management:** Supabase Auth manages JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication. After a user signs in, Supabase provides a JWT.

4.  **Refresh Token Logic:** Supabase Auth supports refresh tokens. You can configure the token expiry time and use the `supabase.auth.refreshSession()` method to refresh the token when it's about to expire.

5.  **"Forgot Password" Flow:** Supabase Auth provides a built-in "Forgot Password" flow. You can trigger this flow by calling `supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail()` with the user's email address. Supabase will send a password reset link to the user's email.

6.  **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA):** Supabase Auth supports 2FA. You can enable 2FA in the Supabase dashboard and use the `supabase.auth.verifyOTP()` method to verify the OTP (One-Time Password) entered by the user.

To implement these features, you'll need to install the `@supabase/supabase-js` library in your React Native project. You'll also need to update your authentication context (`AuthContext.tsx`) to use Supabase Auth methods instead of mock authentication.
